descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D9 · P3 · Daniela

旧的「从口述推断入院状态」代码还留在仓库（AC5 说要删）；问卷里产品名写 Round Companion，票里写 RoundAI

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-06/S27

思路 / Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S18 「AC 5 代码审查：任何地方都没留下按口述判断状态的逻辑」 AC 5 code review: no dictation-based status detection left anywhere

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 No dictation-based status detection exists anywhere in the code: it is removed, not just disconnected（TFA-92584 AC 5）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given origin/main at the build under test

When Search apps/web (src, convex, prompts) for status inference from text: classifyEncounterType, legacyInferEncounterType, encounter/encounter-type.md, encTypeSource writes, regexes over 'admission'/'consult'

Then No code reads the status out of dictation or photo text, whether or not anything calls it

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-92584 AC 5 'exists anywhere, remove it'. What remains on e02167f is listed in testData; whether evaluation-only code counts is Q4

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela；Allure 状态按分诊从 unknown 改成 failed。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92584 ready for qa

app 里已经没有任何地方根据口述来设入院徽章，但旧的识别代码（一个没人调用的 AI action、它的 prompt 和一个关键词匹配函数）还留在代码里，而 AC 5 要求删掉。

Nothing in the app sets the admission badge from dictation any more, but the old detection code (an unused AI action, its prompt and a keyword matcher) is still in the codebase, and AC 5 says to remove it.

依据：code-review: fail-pending-Q4. Still present: legacyInferEncounterType, ai/parsing.classifyEncounterType with its helpers, encounter/encounter-type.md and the encTypeSource schema field. Only tests and evaluation scripts reach them. Q4 (Daniela): does evaluation-only code count as 'exists anywhere'? Note that classifyEncounterType is a public authenticated Convex action, so any signed-in client could call it. If that counts, this is a plain Fail and Tim removes it.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local (source at the dev build sha) 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-06/S18

AC 5 code review: no dictation-based status detection left anywhere

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status fail-pending-Q4 → 待人看（只在开放问题 Q4 上失败，还不算失败 → 待人看）。

Detail:

The status-from-text code is disconnected, but it has not been removed. Four pieces remain at e02167f:

1. **`legacyInferEncounterType`** (convex/lib/encounterType.ts) still holds its regexes over "new admission", "admission note" and similar phrases. Only e2e/unit/encounter-type-set.unit.ts calls it.
2. **`ai/parsing.classifyEncounterType`** is still exported as a public aiAction (an authenticated Convex `action`). It asks the model to read the visit type out of dictation, with helpers `buildEncounterTypeContent`, `readEncounterTypeReply` and `classifyEncounterContent` beside it. Its only caller is e2e/api/encounter-type.live.spec.ts. Nothing in src/ calls it, and it writes nothing.
3. **The prompt `encounter/encounter-type.md`** ("Classify today's hospital visit … from the physician's own dictation") is still in the library and compiled into generated.ts.
4. **`encTypeSource`** remains only as a schema field. The comment says nothing reads or writes it.

Nothing the shipped app runs writes `encType` from text:
- The census scan hardcodes "follow-up".
- Add Patient, Add Resident and the patient screens set it only from the physician's own choice.
- The regexes in src/ that mention "admission" (recall.ts, grounding.ts) do not set the status.

The Then says no such code should exist even if nothing calls it, so the code does not meet it. Every remaining piece is reached only by evaluation scripts or tests, so under the oracle's default each one is pending:Q4 rather than a plain fail. No recorded gap applies.

等开放问题（pendingOn）：

  • Q4

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Q4: does code reached only by evaluation scripts or tests count as 'exists anywhere'? Pieces affected: legacyInferEncounterType, classifyEncounterType with its helpers in convex/lib/encounterType.ts, the encounter/encounter-type.md prompt, and its generated.ts entry.
  • classifyEncounterType is deployed as a public authenticated Convex action. No app client code calls it, but any signed-in client could invoke it directly. This review treats it as evaluation-only (pending:Q4). If Q4 or the product owner counts a deployed public endpoint as reachable from the shipped app, it becomes a plain fail.
  • Q4: does evaluation-only code count as 'exists anywhere'? If it does, legacyInferEncounterType, classifyEncounterType and encounter-type.md make this a fail.
  • classifyEncounterType is a public Convex action on the deployed backend, so an authenticated caller could call it directly even though the shipped client never does. Q4 should say whether a public endpoint the client never calls counts as 'reachable from the shipped app'.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • Whether TFA-92584 AC 5 'remove it' means the evaluation harness (the classifier, legacy baseline and prompt kept for scoring) must also be deleted. That is Q4, a product decision.
  • Whether AC 5's 'exists anywhere, remove it' covers evaluation-only code kept for scoring (Q4).

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：A physician's status badge never changes because of what they dictate or photograph; it changes only when they set it. The leftover classifier, regexes and prompt are dead code that the app never runs. They could only come back into use if someone wires them in again. / None today: physicians still choose the admission status themselves, and no app path changes the badge from dictation or photo text. Text-based classifier code and its prompt remain deployed. A signed-in user could call the classifier action directly, but it only returns a label and writes nothing.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
